features.forgeCredential.body: The cloud agent can push this thread's commits to a new branch of the folder's GitHub or GitLab repository and open a pull request (a merge request on GitLab), through the credential you choose. Nothing existing is overwritten. The credential stays on the server; you are asked before each push unless your project allows them without asking.
features.forgeCredential.buttonUnset: Pushes and pull requests: choose a credential
features.forgeCredential.disabled: Pushes and pull requests from the cloud are turned off for this project.
features.forgeCredential.empty: There is no GitHub or GitLab credential yet. Add one in Credentials, then choose it here.
features.forgeCredential.failed: The choice could not be saved. Try again.
features.forgeCredential.invalid: That is not a GitHub or GitLab credential of this project. Choose another.
features.forgeCredential.listFailed: The GitHub and GitLab credentials could not be listed. Nothing was changed.
features.forgeCredential.title: Pushes and pull requests from the cloud
